purpose: Optional post-MAT2 decoy metadata profiles for privacy workflows and test fixtures.
design_principles: MAT2 cleans first; synthetic metadata is applied only to the cleaned copy.
Generate coherent profiles, not independently randomized tags.
Sparse ordinary-looking metadata is preferred over filling every writable field.
Never copy serial numbers, UUIDs, emails, phone numbers, or full real identities from source datasets.
Do not synthesize semantic content claims (title, subject, artist, album, copyright) by default.
Exact GPS is opt-in and disabled by default; city-level location is safer.
Synthetic fields must be visibly labeled as synthetic inside the application UI, even though the output file contains ordinary metadata values.

timestamp.timezone_source: selected_location.timezone if location enabled else random plausible timezone from profile locale
timestamp.batch_consistency: consistent batch persona may share timezone/device while timestamps vary monotonically or independently

identifiers.instance_id: new random UUID-derived XMP instance identifier
identifiers.serial: only if explicitly enabled; generate synthetic pattern, never source from real device databases

location.city_only: write city/country where format supports it without GPS
location.gps_opt_in: choose a city profile then jitter around city center within declared radius and round precision
location.private_address_policy: never generate or store street addresses

persona.construction: choose locale -> given name + surname from same locale pool
persona.real_identity_policy: components are common-name pools; combinations are synthetic aliases and must not be presented as real people

sparsity.rule: sample fields according to archetype sparsity rather than populating every possible tag
sparsity.reason: ordinary files are often sparse; overpopulation creates an artificial fingerprint

archetypes.notes: Sparse capture metadata. Author usually omitted.
Camera/lens metadata may exist; serial remains off unless explicitly enabled.
Edited exports often lose part of original capture metadata.
Do not synthesize semantic Title/Subject/Keywords by default.
Tier-2 writer; only enable after safe format adapter passes tests.
QuickTime/MP4 metadata varies by device and container.
Do not synthesize Artist/Album/Title/Composer by default.

pdf.special_note: ExifTool writes PDF incrementally; therefore apply only to a MAT2-cleaned output, never directly to the original.

mp3.special_note: ExifTool's ID3 table reports these standard frames as non-writable; use the existing MAT2 runtime's Mutagen dependency if implementing synthetic ID3.

docx.special_note: Implement by rewriting docProps/core.xml in a fresh archive without extracting untrusted paths; do not add a broad Office parser.

odt.special_note: Database supports logical profile, but enable only after a safe ODF adapter is separately reviewed.

consistency_checks.rule: capture/create year must be >= selected device earliest_plausible_year
create/capture must not be later than modify when both are present
given name and surname must come from same selected locale pool
if GPS/location and offset/timezone are both emitted, use selected location timezone
if image dimensions are being synthesized rather than preserved, use a dimension family listed for selected device; default is preserve actual dimensions
never reuse source serials, UUIDs, document IDs, email addresses, phone numbers or owner IDs
title/subject/keywords/artist/album/composer/copyright remain untouched/absent unless a future explicit editorial feature is approved
synthetic writer may only receive a MAT2-cleaned staged output, never the original path
re-read output and confirm original sensitive values are absent and expected synthetic fields match generated profile
profile seed/ID must not be embedded into the exported file
